label: batch-45
tail:
Batch 45 authoring is complete for `qft-mg03` and its examples page: **9 A-page items and 3 B-page items** are scaffolded. Two self-contained definitions are `ready`; the other 10 items are `escalated` because their QFT-MG01 or QFT-MF01/MF02/MF03 prerequisites remain unregistered or open.

I added a local photon-energy multiplier definition after finding that the available QFT-MG01 photon-space draft defines the transverse space but not \(\omega(\mathbf k)=|\mathbf k|\). Its proof and the coherent cutoff argument are complete conditionally on that supplier.

- [Batch manifest](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-45.pages.json>), [authoring notes](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-45.notes.md>), [source coverage](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-45.coverage.json>), [proof contracts](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-45.proof-contracts.json>) and [cross-batch dependencies](</Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-45.cross-batch-dependencies.json>)

Scoped checks passed: 12-item content policy and dependency checks, 9 proof contracts, proof layout (32 steps, 0 defects), renderer checks (14 files), 11 harvested source results, and 3/3 verified source fetches. The source review includes [Tong’s QFT Chapter 6](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/qft/qfthtml/S6.html) and [Srednicki’s QFT §55](https://www.physics.ucsb.edu/~mark/ms-qft-DRAFT.pdf), which covers the transverse projector and free photon frequency convention.

Run-wide checks remain open: the shared batch dependency file is stale, item-level checks report unrelated empty inventories and mismatches, and proof-contract coverage stops at the empty `rpm-external-charge-examples` inventory. I left those owner-managed records unchanged. The authored readiness records are not independent approval.
